{
  "candidate_rtl": "`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 64 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 6 && W == 64) begin : fast64
        wire [7:0] group_valid;
        wire [7:0] group_enable;
        wire [7:0] group_winner;
        wire [7:0] low_bit0;
        wire [7:0] low_bit1;
        wire [7:0] low_bit2;

        genvar g, j;
        for (g = 0; g < 8; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [7:0] x;
            wire [7:0] local_winner;
            assign x = input_unencoded[g*8 +: 8];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;
            if (g == 7) begin : top_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : other_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[7:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

            for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin : local_bits
                if (j == 7) begin : top_bit
                    assign local_winner[j] = x[j];
                end else begin : other_bit
                    assign local_winner[j] = x[j] & ~(|x[7:j+1]);
                end
                if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : zero_default
                    assign output_unencoded[g*8+j] = group_enable[g] & ~(|x[7:1]);
                end else begin : ordinary_output
                    assign output_unencoded[g*8+j] = group_enable[g] & local_winner[j];
                end
            end

            assign low_bit0[g] = group_enable[g] &
                (local_winner[1] | local_winner[3] | local_winner[5] | local_winner[7]);
            assign low_bit1[g] = group_enable[g] &
                (local_winner[2] | local_winner[3] | local_winner[6] | local_winner[7]);
            assign low_bit2[g] = group_enable[g] &
                (local_winner[4] | local_winner[5] | local_winner[6] | local_winner[7]);
        end

        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
        assign output_encoded[0] = |low_bit0;
        assign output_encoded[1] = |low_bit1;
        assign output_encoded[2] = |low_bit2;
        assign output_encoded[3] = group_winner[1] | group_winner[3] | group_winner[5] | group_winner[7];
        assign output_encoded[4] = group_winner[2] | group_winner[3] | group_winner[6] | group_winner[7];
        assign output_encoded[5] = group_winner[4] | group_winner[5] | group_winner[6] | group_winner[7];
    end else begin : original_parameters
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};

        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end

        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

`default_nettype wire
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths terminate at output_unencoded after priority selection and binary-to-one-hot decoding. This serial encoder/decoder dependency and its shared control fanout dominate the reported 1.73 ns arrival.",
  "rewrite": "For the fixed 64-bit MSB-priority configuration, use eight parallel 8-bit priority groups. Compute higher-group exclusion and local winners independently, produce one-hot outputs directly, and form the binary index with balanced reduction expressions instead of cascaded encoded-index multiplexers. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Direct one-hot generation removes the binary-index decode from the measured critical-path topology. Maximum arrival is expected to improve, although encoded-output paths may become limiting. No mapped timing result is available; a numerical gain cannot be guaranteed without the specified synthesis and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel local winner and group-exclusion logic while eliminating the 64-way output decoder in the specialized configuration. Logic sharing should keep area competitive, but compliance with the 1713.518400 um2 cap and library electrical limits must be confirmed by mapping and electrical checks.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Purely combinational, with unchanged ports, signedness, parameters, and latency. For WIDTH=64 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, the highest asserted input wins. All-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=64'b1, exactly preserving the reference's ungated one-hot default. Other configurations use the original parameterized logic, including its truncation and LSB-priority defaults. No assumptions, state, helper modules, or undefined output assignments are introduced."
}
